hero.title: Integrating Technology, Inspiring Learners.
paragraphs: As a QTS-certified EdTech Coach at the British International School Hanoi, I am a proven leader in developing and implementing data-driven EdTech strategy. My role encompasses strategic planning, change management, and designing impactful professional development that drives meaningful technology integration to enhance student outcomes. I've led comprehensive EdTech audits, developed AI policies, and delivered targeted professional development programs that achieved 95% positive staff feedback while improving digital competency across the school.

My path into education is shaped by a background in software development, digital humanities, and international teaching. That mix gives me a practical lens: I understand what's technically possible, but I'm equally focused on what genuinely works in the classroom. As a Computer Science teacher delivering IBDP and IGCSE curriculum, I've achieved 97% A*-C in IGCSE and 88% Grades 5-7 in IBDP CS, while pioneering innovative programs like the Student Tech Ambassador initiative and saving over $18,500 through strategic hardware selection processes.
